summary: CION Investment Corp filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing its entry into an Amended and Restated LLC Agreement for Senior Loan Fund Partners, LLC, a newly formed joint venture capitalized via $125.0M of senior secured notes (priced at 98.25%) and $59.7M of LLC interests, with CION holding 80% common and institutional investors 20% preferred carrying an 11.50% cumulative dividend. Proceeds funded CION's sale of 20 first-lien loans (par ~$180.3M, fair value ~$180.0M, 99.8% of par), netting CION roughly $132.3M for debt repayment. The JV has a two-year investment period; notes price at 3-month SOFR+4.75% (1.00% floor), seven-year maturity, investment grade, with a 100% cash flow sweep and unanimous four-manager board control. Watch JV leverage, board deadlock risk, and CION's retained 80% exposure.
